program: EIC Accelerator (Horizon Europe, EIC Work Programme 2026), full proposal Step 2, Accelerator Open, blended finance
stopper_list: A non-associated third-country company holding the GO (here the Delaware Inc.) must prove effective establishment in an EU Member State or Associated Country by the time the full proposal is submitted; relocation must happen before Step 2 (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/52598755-1351-4b54-b46b-e2682d0a3aec_en?filename=EIC-Work-Programme-2026.pdf ; https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-funding-opportunities/eic-accelerator_en)
The full proposal must use the same PIC as the short proposal (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/52598755-1351-4b54-b46b-e2682d0a3aec_en?filename=EIC-Work-Programme-2026.pdf)

GO validity: 2026 cut-offs, last 4 Nov 2026 17:00 Brussels; 2027 dates only in the 2027 Work Programme, none published (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-frequently-asked-questions/faqs-eic-accelerator_en)
Three unsuccessful submissions by the same legal entity at any stage end EIC Accelerator access under Horizon Europe (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-frequently-asked-questions/faqs-eic-accelerator_en)

Applicant must be a single SME; linked or parent enterprises count in the SME test (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/52598755-1351-4b54-b46b-e2682d0a3aec_en?filename=EIC-Work-Programme-2026.pdf)

Mandatory declaration that none of the project activities started before submission (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/dc379cf9-2917-4f92-824d-64ea3a116df2_en?filename=Annexes%20for%20the%20EIC%20Accelerator%20full%20proposal%20%28WP2026%29.zip)

Grant covers TRL 6-8 only; TRL 9 work must be equity-funded and may be cut by the jury (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/9d96fbf3-4d85-4ad0-9483-c77ce348111d_en?filename=EIC%20Accelerator%20guide%20for%20applicants_WP26.pdf)

Grant max 70% of eligible costs and EUR 2,499,999; lump-sum table with 25% indirect on personnel and purchase costs excluding subcontracting; equipment as depreciation (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/52598755-1351-4b54-b46b-e2682d0a3aec_en?filename=EIC-Work-Programme-2026.pdf)

30% co-funding of grant work packages from own resources; no work package may mix grant and investment (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/9d96fbf3-4d85-4ad0-9483-c77ce348111d_en?filename=EIC%20Accelerator%20guide%20for%20applicants_WP26.pdf)

Mandatory package: Part B max 20 pages, PDF pitch deck, video up to 3 min, lump-sum table, implementation plan max 10 pages, financial plan and equity needed, FTO analysis or 2-page note, LoIs on template, CV links (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-frequently-asked-questions/faqs-eic-accelerator_en)

EIC Fund invests only in companies established and operating in EU/AC, or in a parent that is itself EU/AC-established and an SME; parent must be declared in the application (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/6df458e7-fa47-4ace-93fa-86099606bdb0_en?filename=EIC_Fund_Investment_2026_guidelines_f.pdf)

IP must be owned by or accessible to the applicant and kept in the EU; otherwise investment is blocked (Bucket 0 H) (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/6df458e7-fa47-4ace-93fa-86099606bdb0_en?filename=EIC_Fund_Investment_2026_guidelines_f.pdf)
Funding type fixed at full proposal and the jury cannot change it; grant-only must show resources to scale up (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/eic-frequently-asked-questions/faqs-eic-accelerator_en)

Interviews: technology-expert interview max 3 participants, no consultants; jury interview only staff, board and investors (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/9d96fbf3-4d85-4ad0-9483-c77ce348111d_en?filename=EIC%20Accelerator%20guide%20for%20applicants_WP26.pdf)

Portal-only items: mandatory declarations, security questions, consent to share data with the EIC Fund (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/52598755-1351-4b54-b46b-e2682d0a3aec_en?filename=EIC-Work-Programme-2026.pdf)

Part B must disclose which generative-AI tools were used and how (https://eic.ec.europa.eu/document/download/dc379cf9-2917-4f92-824d-64ea3a116df2_en?filename=Annexes%20for%20the%20EIC%20Accelerator%20full%20proposal%20%28WP2026%29.zip)
